question: Who among the following Mauryan rulers fought the Kalinga War in 261 BC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashoka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Ashoka**

 
• Ashoka also is known as "Devanampiya".
 
• Piyadasi was the son of Mauryan Emperor Bindusara and was born in 304 BC.
 
 
• His reign lasted from 268 BC to 232 BC.
 
• Once he became King, he started expanding his empires by conquest, in the ninth year of his reign he waged a war with Kalinga (present-day Odisha).
